title: David’s Victories

questions.question: Which nation did David defeat and subdue first in this summary?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:1 (ESV): "After this David defeated the Philistines and subdued them..."

questions.question: How many of the Moabites did David kill?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:2 (ESV): "...two lines he measured to be put to death, and one full line to be spared."

questions.question: What did David do with the silver and gold he won?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:11 (ESV): "These also King David dedicated to the LORD, together with the silver and gold..."

questions.question: Who was over the army?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:16 (ESV): "Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army..."

questions.question: Who was the recorder?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:16 (ESV): "...and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder..."

questions.question: What city did David take from the Philistines (Lit. Bridle of the Mother)?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:1 (ESV): "...and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines."

questions.question: Who was the King of Zobah that David defeated?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:3 (ESV): "David also defeated Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah..."

questions.question: How many horsemen did David take from Hadadezer?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:4 (ESV): "And David took from him 1,700 horsemen..."

questions.question: What did David do to the chariot horses?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:4 (ESV): "David hamstrung all the chariot horses but left enough for 100 chariots."

questions.question: David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down 18,000 ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:13 (ESV): "And David made a name for himself... when he returned from striking down 18,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt."

questions.question: Which priest was the son of Ahitub?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:17 (ESV): "and Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests..."

questions.question: Who was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:18 (ESV): "and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites..."

questions.question: What were David's sons?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:18 (ESV): "...and David's sons were priests." (Note: Hebrew cohanim, usually priests, sometimes interpreted as chief officials).

questions.question: Who sent his son Joram to bless David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:9-10 (ESV): "When Toi king of Hamath heard... Toi sent his son Joram..."

questions.question: From which cities of Hadadezer did David take very much bronze?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 8:8 (ESV): "And from Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took very much bronze."

key_verse_text: So David reigned over all Israel. And David administered justice and equity to all his people. (ESV)
